name: Harvey Oak
learned: Harvey Oak has owned the Harvey Oak Supply Store for over twenty years. He knows every customer by name and keeps the shelves stocked with everything the town needs. He takes pride in fair prices and honest dealings.
currently: Status: Saturday, February 18, 2023 – Harvey Oak remains at home. He awoke early as usual, followed his routine of reading books, short rest breaks, and enjoying a quiet cup of coffee. After finishing his personal tasks, he settled in to reflect on the calm closure of Friday’s shift (ending 12:01 AM at the downtown supply store). Harvey felt present, unhurried, and grateful for each moment—much like his own words: “I feel present. And that, for me, is enough.” No work or scheduled activities are planned today; he intends to continue his personal routine until Monday’s return to the store (opening Monday, February 19 at 8:00 AM).
lifestyle: Harvey Oak goes to bed around 10pm, awakes up around 5:30am.
